repos_data.description: CaptainHook is a very flexible git hook manager for software developers that makes sharing git hooks with your team a breeze.
🦎 Githooks: per-repo and shared Git hooks with version control and auto update. [✩Star] if you're using it!

sofagent is an open-source FDE Harness for AI coding agents — on entry, write your business judgment into files (workflows, ontology, AI nodes); after departure, audit every change against them. 28 codified audit rules, tamper-evident chain, snapshots, and an MCP toolset (104 tools, 12 plugins). Everything can be FDEing.
Stops your AI coding agent from writing calls to functions that don't exist, before the edit lands. Deterministic, no LLM, no API keys.
Reviews changes against the rules your team actually wrote — while the agent works, not after. An independent judge refutes findings before you see them. Free, self-hosted, your own model key.

Oh My Zsh plugin binding git identity to workspace directories: per-directory commit e-mail, gh account and SSH key, optional SSH commit signing, and an audit that finds repositories already holding the wrong identity.
